<action type="say">
That read‑only look in Google Calendar usually means the event is owned by the school’s system, and Google is just showing a synced copy. In that case, Google can’t actually change the time—you have to do it through the school’s side.

Here are your realistic options:

1) Look for a reschedule link in the event  
   - Open the event in Google Calendar and check:
     - Description/notes area  
     - Location field  
   Often schools include a link like “Manage or reschedule this booking” or a portal URL.  
   - If you see one, click it and follow the steps there to move it to Sat 2025‑12‑13, 6:00–6:30 pm.

2) Use the school portal directly  
   - Log in to the same parent/school portal you used to originally book it.  
   - Go to the “Appointments” / “Parent‑Teacher Conferences” / “Teacher Meetings” section.  
   - Find the booking on Fri 2025‑12‑12, 6:00–6:30 pm and see if there’s:
     - a “Reschedule” button, or  
     - a way to cancel and then rebook the teacher for Sat 2025‑12‑13 at 6:00–6:30 pm.  

3) Contact the teacher or office  
   - If there’s no reschedule option, the system may lock the schedule. In that case:
     - Reply to the confirmation email you got for the meeting, or  
     - Email the teacher / school office and ask to move it to Sat 2025‑12‑13, 6:00–6:30 pm Central.  
   They can change it on their side; your Google Calendar will then update automatically.

If you’d like, I can also walk you through creating a separate personal reminder event in Google Calendar at Sat 6:00–6:30 pm (“Teacher Meeting – NEW time”) so you’re set for your preferred slot while you sort out the official reschedule with the school.</action>
